List checkpoints and whether they are installed

Source: R/models.R
laya_models.Rd

List checkpoints and whether they are installed

Usage

laya_models()

Value

A data frame with one row per checkpoint: checkpoint, installed, path (where it was found, or where it would be installed), source ("layaR" for the model root, "shared" for the cross-SDK cache, NA when not installed), layout ("fused" or "split") and size_gb.

Examples

laya_models()
#>        checkpoint installed                                             path
#> 1    multilingual     FALSE    /home/runner/.cache/R/layaR/onnx/multilingual
#> 2         english     FALSE         /home/runner/.cache/R/layaR/onnx/english
#> 3 typed-decisions     FALSE /home/runner/.cache/R/layaR/onnx/typed-decisions
#>   source layout size_gb
#> 1   <NA>   <NA>      NA
#> 2   <NA>   <NA>      NA
#> 3   <NA>   <NA>      NA
